MT-203 owns the central host lifecycle contract and scoped evidence.

AC199-6: Actual Vulkan backend/device, native GUI action/error and affected GPU memory/lifetime failures are observable through existing internal_diagnostics and correlated standalone Palmistry records, under original allowlist/privacy. Neither a source declaration nor configured backend label proves event wiring or crash survival.
